scripts.pdf: npm run pdf:es && npm run pdf:va && npm run pdf:ca
scripts.pdf:es: astro build && cross-env PUPPETEER_PROTOCOL_TIMEOUT=1800000 npx starlight-to-pdf https://sergarb1.github.io/ApuntesProgramacion -p public/pdf -f ApuntesProgramacion-es --footer scripts/pdf-footer.html --header scripts/pdf-header.html --preceding-html scripts/pdf-cover.html --print-bg --exclude /ApuntesProgramacion/va/ --exclude /ApuntesProgramacion/ca/ --timeout 1800000 --scroll-delay 10 --styles scripts/pdf-print.css
